messages:
Maya (AE): New POC: Helio Analytics. 10-day timeline. Start hosted keys in EU, with option to migrate to Dedicated + VPC mid-POC. Need a concise internal runbook and who owns what.
Ishaan (SE): I can own onboarding. Quick Q: expected peak qps and whether they need embeddings.
Maya (AE): They said ~40 rps peak, chat mainly; embeddings maybe in week 2. EU-only.
Greta (Platform): Quick safe path: 1) create trial org in eu-west, 2) issue ephemeral API key + impose org cap, 3) prepare infra ticket for Dedicated (lead time ~8-10bd) if requested.
Omar (Security): Requirements: SOC2 ok, KMS preferred, minimal retention. I'll draft answers for their security questionnaire.
Ishaan (SE): Runbook (short):
- Step 1: Create org helio-poc (eu-west-1) + ephemeral key
- Step 2: Apply rate limit policy (50 rps) and billing cap $800
- Step 3: Share quickstart repo + cURL examples
- Step 4: Collect ops/security contact and data types allowed
- Step 5: If Dedicated asked, open POC-Ded ticket and schedule sizing call with Greta
Greta (Platform): Internal commands (examples):
```
rwctl org create --name "helio-poc" --region eu-west-1 --tier trial
rwctl api-keys create --org helio-poc --note "ephemeral-poc"
```
ticket-bot: POC-DED-412 created by Greta for Helio Analytics.
Maya (AE): Thanks — Ishaan owns onboarding, Greta owns infra path, Omar security. I'll schedule kickoff with Helio. :thumbsup:
